editorial.blurb: Step behind door 202 in a Lincoln Park hotel hallway for an intimate 17-course omakase experience where Chef Chris orchestrates each bite with artistic precision—no sign, no menu, just six seats and an unforgettable evening.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive ready to linger and connect with your dining companions; the chef encourages encores of favorite bites and the experience unfolds at its own pace, followed by vinyl-spinning in the lounge if the mood strikes.
